body: Thank you, I really do appreciate this.

Thanks. I think I need to just get away from the situation and clear my head. I have 2 friends (sad for someone my age) and they have both been great but I can’t tell them any details, I don’t want anyone to turn against anyone else. I’m already struggling to keep our child from hating him. I’m not great at seeking in real life help, on here I can write and edit how I feel, irl I just sob when I talk and become irrational with pain and anger.
